name: Basilika Wilten
kurzbeschreibung: The baroque Basilica **Wilten** impresses with its magnificent interior featuring pink marble and the monumental dome.
beschreibung: Basilica of Wilten – The Basilica of Wilten is a cultural highlight in Innsbruck and attracts visitors from around the world. This Baroque basilica impresses with its opulent interior featuring pink marble and a monumental dome. The exhibition masterfully blends historical heritage with modern presentation. Interactive stations make the visit an exciting experience for children and young people alike. A museum shop and café complete the offering. Located in the heart of Innsbruck, the Basilica of Wilten is easily accessible on foot or by public transport. Its central location makes it the perfect starting point for a cultural stroll through the city. Whether in summer or winter, the Basilica of Wilten is always worth a visit.
